summary: The article accurately reports the interest rates for small savings schemes for the July-September 2026 quarter, which have remained unchanged from the previous quarter. The details provided for each scheme, including rates, maturity periods, and tax benefits, are consistent with authoritative sources.

claims.claim: The interest rates for small savings schemes for the July-September 2026 quarter have been announced and remain unchanged from the previous quarter.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm that the Ministry of Finance announced on June 30, 2026, that the rates for July-September 2026 would remain unchanged from the previous quarter.
The PPF interest rate is confirmed at 7.1% per annum for the July-September 2026 quarter.

claims.claim: Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS): 8.2% per annum
claims.note: The SCSS interest rate is confirmed at 8.2% per annum for the July-September 2026 quarter.
The SSY interest rate is confirmed at 8.2% per annum for the July-September 2026 quarter.

claims.claim: Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP): 7.5% per annum (matures in 115 months)
claims.note: The KVP interest rate is confirmed at 7.5% per annum, with maturity in 115 months (9 years and 7 months).
The Post Office Time Deposit rates are confirmed as 1-Year: 6.9%, 2-Year: 7.0%, 3-Year: 7.1%, and 5-Year: 7.5% for the July-September 2026 quarter.
The Post Office Recurring Deposit rate is confirmed at 6.7% per annum for the July-September 2026 quarter.

claims.claim: Many of these schemes, like PPF, SCSS, and NSC, offer attractive tax benefits under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, allowing you to reduce your taxable income up to ₹1.5 lakh per financial year. Interest earned on PPF and SSY is also tax-free.
claims.note: PPF, SCSS, and NSC investments qualify for deductions under Section 80C up to ₹1.5 lakh. Interest on PPF and SSY is tax-exempt.
